rust_summary: an item's default components on `Host` (`native_item_has_component`), which `ItemResource::without_component` reads to record a removal.
doc_summary: `item_has_component(item, component)` is whether an item has a data component by default (`Item.components().has`), with data packs' and mods' changes; `ItemResource::without_component(host, &id)` uses it to record a removal (`!id`) in a stack's patch, as vanilla's `PatchedDataComponentMap.remove` does. Bundles need "hooks": @API:item_components@.
